label: order to production process: Execute engineering change management — Assess and apply any material or design modifications required during production to align with customer specifications or standards.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

ORDER-TO-PRODUCTION PROCESSES:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
- Captures incoming customer orders from sales opportunities
- Validates fulfillment eligibility: customer account eligibility, credit limits, inventory availability
- Automates order creation workflow
- Coordinates with procurement and production planning systems
- Part of order-to-production process flow

ENGINEERING CHANGE MANAGEMENT (Primary Agent):
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
- Automates engineering change processing and material lifecycle coordination
- Capabilities: synchronize-engineering-changes, assess-engineering-changes, initiate-engineering-change, coordinate-bom-updates, evaluate-change-impact, manage-material-provisioning
- Part of: proc_EngChangeAndProcurement_v1, proc_ServiceToProduction_v1, proc_QualityDrivenMfgSupplyChain_v1
- Best fit for: Executing ECM with material/design modifications during production

BOM COMPLIANCE & VALIDATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1
- Validates BOM against regulatory/supplier requirements
- Capabilities: validate-bom-compliance, assess-material-compliance, verify-component-standards

MANUFACTURING CHANGE ORCHESTRATION:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Part of proc_ManufacturingChangeCompliance_v1 (BPMN process)

PROCUREMENT & PURCHASE ORDERS:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 (PO creation/approval)
- Enables PO lifecycle management: creation, approval workflows, real-time status tracking
- Exposes: PurchaseOrder, Vendor entities
- Capabilities: coordinate-vendor-procurement, validate-purchase-orders, verify-vendor-compliance

INCIDENT & SAFETY COMPLIANCE MONITORING:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
- Automates vendor safety compliance verification across POs and contracts

args.reason: This agent automates engineering change processing and material provisioning with capabilities to assess, initiate, and synchronize engineering changes—directly fulfilling the requirement to execute ECM with material/design modifications during production.
